_comment: Frozen configuration for the Nexus Research v0 baseline. Changing any value makes a new baseline, not a rerun.

inference_settings._source: inherited unchanged: src/model/manager.py (openrouter/gemini-3-flash-preview entry), configs/agents/tool_calling.py, configs/tool_calling_agent.py
inference_settings.inherited_fallback_model: openrouter/gemini-2.5-flash (google/gemini-2.5-flash), configured but effectively unreachable for chat errors: src/model/openrouter/chat.py returns a failed response instead of raising, so src/model/manager.py never falls back. The harness fails any task that logs a fallback or a usage line for a model other than the pin.

judge.prompt: search_agent/prompts.py GRADER_TEMPLATE, verbatim; parsed with scripts_evaluation/evaluate_with_openai.py parse_judge_response
judge.note: Official primary judge is Qwen3-32B (needs GPUs); BrowseComp-Plus reports GPT-4.1 within 1% of it.

scoring.accuracy: judged correct / number of selected tasks; every task whose status is not 'completed' counts as incorrect
scoring.consistency_rule: two runs are materially consistent when their correct counts differ by at most max(1, ceil(0.10 * n)) and both have the same number of non-completed tasks or fewer than 10% each
